definitions.explanation: to coordinate timing or data between devices or systems

examples.japanese: スマホとパソコンを{同期|どうき}する。
examples.english: I sync my smartphone and computer.

examples.japanese: クラウドと{同期|どうき}してデータを{保存|ほぞん}する。
examples.english: I save data by syncing with the cloud.

examples.japanese: カレンダーを{自動的|じどうてき}に{同期|どうき}するように{設定|せってい}した。
examples.english: I set up the calendar to sync automatically.

notes:
TECHNOLOGY CONTEXT:
{同期|どうき}する is commonly used in computing and technology contexts:
- データを{同期|どうき}する - to sync data
- {自動|じどう}{同期|どうき} - automatic synchronization
- {同期|どうき}{中|ちゅう} - syncing in progress

RELATED NOUN:
{同期|どうき} also means "same period/year" and refers to people who joined a company or school in the same year. This is a different meaning from the synchronization sense.
